name: Potion of Longevity

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Your body grows 1d6 + 6 years younger (each later dose risks aging you instead).
text: When you drink this potion, your physical age is reduced by 1d6 + 6 years, to a minimum of 13. Each time you subsequently drink one, there is a 10 percent cumulative chance that you instead age by 1d6 + 6 years. Suspended in the amber liquid are a scorpion's tail, an adder's fang, a dead spider and a tiny heart that, against all reason, is still beating. These ingredients vanish when the potion is opened.
